claim: Exploration in the task space is faster than exploration in the actuator space for learning inverse models in redundant robots.
falsifier: Compare learning speed of inverse models in a redundant robot when exploration is performed in task space versus actuator space under controlled conditions.

conditions: for learning inverse models in redundant robots
exclusions: limited to the reported robotic system, task space, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished

title: Exploration in the task–speed of learning inverse principle
